sources.title: Indiana Department of Environmental Management, Office of Air Quality: Notice of 30-day period for public comment - preliminary findings regarding a new source construction and FESOP for Microsoft EKI Campus in St. Joseph County (FESOP No. F 141-50527-00655)
sources.publisher: Indiana Department of Environmental Management (IDEM), Office of Air Quality
sources.summary: IDEM states that it has received an application from Microsoft EKI Campus, located at 12501 Cleveland Road, Granger, IN 46530, for a new source construction and Federally Enforceable State Operating Permit (FESOP No. F 141-50527-00655), and that, if approved by the Office of Air Quality, the proposed permit 'would allow Microsoft EKI Campus to construct and operate a new stationary data center'. The applicant intends to construct and operate new equipment that will emit air pollutants, with potential emissions limited below the Title V and PSD major thresholds; IDEM has prepared preliminary findings (a draft permit and supporting documents), sent copies to the Mishawaka-Penn-Harris Public Library and opened a 30-day public comment period that begins on the day the notice is posted on IDEM's website. After the comment period IDEM will issue a Notice of Decision. The notice is a draft air permit for the source's emission units; it is not a building or zoning consent and no construction is reported.
sources.date_semantics: IDEM's Northern Indiana public-notice page captured the same day (source us-chicago-in-p4-idem-public-notices-northern-indiana-20261026) lists this notice for St. Joseph County with the public notice period 10/26/2026 - 11/25/2026; the notice says the posting date marks the start of the comment period, so it was published on 26 October 2026 (the PDF itself was created on 23 October 2026 and its file name carries the 25 November 2026 end date). The status observation (announced) is the 26 October 2026 publication.
sources.personal_data_note: The notice names IDEM staff contacts; no personal names, telephone numbers or e-mail addresses are copied.
